title: Use PerfView to View Event Trace Data

facts.text: PerfView tool views Business Central Server event trace data stored in .etl files for performance analysis.
Download and install PerfView from github.com/microsoft/perfview before viewing event trace data.
Open PerfView and navigate to the .etl file using the left pane directory browser.
Double-click the .etl file to load it, then double-click Events to view trace contents.
Double-click individual trace events to view detailed information about each event.
